name: Vila Real
mandate: PrompTugal.news Vila Real: AI and technology in Vila Real, a university and science-park city whose centre of gravity is the UTAD campus and the Regia Douro Park, and what reaches Vila Real from Trás-os-Montes, Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Vila Real is the seat of UTAD, the University of Trás-os-Montes e Alto Douro, which hosts AI seminars, joins AI research consortia and takes part in the national IAedu pilot. Next to it sits the Regia Douro Park, a science and technology park with about 160 companies, which backed the DTech 2026 conference on AI in business. The council appears in the AI story as a supporter of that event and as a past partner of IBM's announced innovation centre, while its own news page showed no AI use in what we could read.

look.landmark: Palácio de Mateus, the baroque manor on the Douro wine country's most famous label
look.motif: Marão and Alvão mountains, Douro vineyard terraces, black pottery of Bisalhães, a university town in the hills

ai_news.title: Vila Real's council backs school libraries' month on literacy and AI
ai_news.summary: The council says Vila Real's school libraries, with its support, ran October's international school libraries month under a theme of literacy and artificial intelligence, with readings, workshops, author visits and theatre for about 300 pupils. The page describes the reading activities and gives no detail of AI content.
ai_news.ai_path: The council's own news item frames a school programme around AI literacy: one step from AI, and the first AI mention we found on the council's news page.

ai_news.title: DTech 2026 puts AI at work on stage in Vila Real
ai_news.summary: A two-day event on 14 and 15 October at the Teatro de Vila Real with talks on how firms bring AI into their business and how it changes jobs, plus a careers fair and workshops at UTAD. Organised by Outsmartis, Kropie and What When Where, with the council, Regia Douro Park and UTAD Solutions Consulting as supporters.
ai_news.ai_path: A conference in Vila Real about AI in business and jobs: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: UTAD hosts a workshop on AI and skills in animal production
ai_news.summary: The agrarian and veterinary school hosts an international workshop under the European VITAL project (25 partners, nine countries) on how AI and precision livestock farming change the skills the sector needs. The article does not give the workshop date.
ai_news.ai_path: A workshop at Vila Real's university on AI in animal production and training: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: INESC TEC researchers meet at UTAD to talk AI and scientific careers
ai_news.summary: INESC TEC's annual strategic meeting was held at UTAD on 11 September, run for the first time by the BEAR early-career network. AI was one of the two themes, with a keynote on its future and working groups.
ai_news.ai_path: A national research institute debates AI at Vila Real's university: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: A UTAD lecturer joins a world panel on generative AI in engineering teaching
ai_news.summary: At the IFAC world congress in Busan (23 to 28 August 2026) a UTAD lecturer sat on a panel on adopting generative AI in engineering education and is part of an international team surveying how AI is used to teach automatic control. The event was in South Korea, so this is UTAD's role abroad.
ai_news.ai_path: A Vila Real university researcher in an international study of AI in teaching: directly about AI, with the event held abroad.

ai_news.title: Regional press association debates AI in newsrooms in Vila Real
ai_news.summary: The 2026 Technical Days of the Regional Press, run by the national press association with the support of the council and the Museu da Vila Velha, closed in Vila Real with AI in journalism as a main theme. A UTAD professor and INESC TEC researcher explained how AI algorithms work.
ai_news.ai_path: A national sector event held in Vila Real on AI in the media, with a UTAD speaker and council support: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: UTAD hosts an international seminar on AI in agricultural sciences
ai_news.summary: AITRAS ran on 5 and 6 March at UTAD's agrarian and veterinary school, with speakers from several European universities and cases from animal production, forestry, viticulture and the agrifood sector.
ai_news.ai_path: A seminar on AI in teaching and research, hosted in Vila Real: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: UTAD project builds AI to help triage in emergency rooms, with an event of 200 people
ai_news.summary: The AITriage4SU project, led from UTAD, held a scientific meeting on 31 January in Porto with about 200 participants on AI for adult emergency triage. The team showed how large language models normalise free-text triage complaints, with first results.
ai_news.ai_path: A Vila Real university research project on AI for clinical decisions: directly about AI, with the event held in Porto.

ai_news.title: UTAD joins a 36-month project using AI to fight the Asian hornet
ai_news.summary: The EdgeOnVespa consortium, led by the company Dotlabs with MORE CoLAB, the national beekeepers' federation and Anbeit, builds an edge-computing system that uses AI to find and track the hornet and trigger control. It is co-financed by the NORTE2030 programme.
ai_news.ai_path: A university takes part in an AI detection project: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: UTAD joins the national IAedu pilot for AI models in higher education
ai_news.summary: The FCT's IAedu platform, still in beta, gives students, teachers and researchers at participating institutions access to AI models, and the FCT added four language models in January.
ai_news.ai_path: Vila Real's university is a pilot site for national AI tools: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: UTAD and Bragança join a regional AI-assisted teaching hub
ai_news.summary: UTAD and the Polytechnic of Bragança join the HUB Digital of the INOV-NORTE consortium with the Polytechnic of Porto. It uses an AI virtual assistant, still in training, to help lecturers design more innovative classes, with a launch planned for the second semester of 2026.
ai_news.ai_path: A Vila Real university takes part in a consortium building an AI teaching assistant: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: UTAD helps write Portugal's first white paper on AI in journalism
ai_news.summary: A study led by NOVA's social sciences faculty and promoted by the Gulbenkian Foundation, based on answers from 295 journalists, proposes 10 measures for responsible AI use in newsrooms. A UTAD lecturer sat on the project team.
ai_news.ai_path: A national study of AI in media with a UTAD researcher on the team: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Vila Real's children's assembly debates AI
ai_news.summary: Forty-five pupils from years 3 and 4 took part in the council's children's municipal assembly, where every school took AI as its theme and the pupils wrote 12 motions on using AI with critical thinking. The council's deputy mayor spoke at it.
ai_news.ai_path: A council civic event with AI as its set theme: directly about AI. Older than the 2026 items.

ai_news.title: UTAD gets national funding for an AI emergency triage project
ai_news.summary: The FCT approved a project to explore AI models that support triage decisions for adults in emergency rooms, with a total budget of about 124 thousand euros and partners including INESC TEC's UTAD pole, INEGI and a Porto hospital unit.
ai_news.ai_path: A research grant for AI in healthcare at Vila Real's university: directly about AI. Older than the 2026 items.

ai_map.name: Universidade de Trás-os-Montes e Alto Douro (UTAD)
ai_map.what: Vila Real's public university. Hosted the AITRAS seminar in March 2026 and the INESC TEC strategic meeting in September 2026, and is a pilot site for the FCT's IAedu platform.
ai_map.ai_path: Hosts AI research, seminars and national AI tools.

ai_map.name: Regia Douro Park
ai_map.what: Science and technology park in Vila Real, ten years old in 2026, with about 160 companies, 1,000 jobs and about 50 million euros of turnover in 2025. Hosts an incubator and accelerator and backed DTech 2026. The Lusa report does not mention AI.
ai_map.ai_path: Home of tech firms and supporter of an AI conference.

ai_map.name: Município de Vila Real
ai_map.what: The council supported DTech 2026, the 2026 regional press days on AI in journalism and the school libraries' AI literacy month, ran a children's assembly on AI in 2025, and signed the 2022 cooperation protocol with IBM's Softinsa and UTAD. We found no AI in its own services.
ai_map.ai_path: Backs AI events and AI literacy in schools, with no AI use in its own services found.

ai_map.what: Named as an organiser of DTech 2026 in Vila Real. The article does not say what it does and we found no page of its own.

ai_map.what: Named as an organiser of DTech 2026. The article does not say what it does.

ai_map.what: In June 2022 IBM announced a centre at Regia Douro Park, with a branch at UTAD, for smart cities, AI and cloud, with up to 300 jobs in three years. We found no 2025 or 2026 update, so its present state is unknown.
ai_map.ai_path: An announced AI and cloud centre in Vila Real.

ai_map.name: INESC TEC (UTAD pole)
ai_map.what: National research institute that held its September 2026 strategic meeting at UTAD with AI as a main theme. The page does not describe a permanent Vila Real unit.

ai_map.what: A 36-month NORTE2030 co-financed project using AI and edge computing against the Asian hornet, with UTAD as a partner. The page does not place the lead company in Vila Real.
ai_map.ai_path: An AI detection and control system with a Vila Real university partner.

ai_map.name: FCT IAedu
ai_map.what: National platform run by the Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia giving higher education access to AI models, with UTAD in its pilot. National, not based in Vila Real.

ai_map.name: Vila Real Innovation Hub (Regia Douro Park)
ai_map.what: A Regia Douro Park community for remote workers, freelancers and digital entrepreneurs in Vila Real, backed by UTAD from May 2026. More than 50 people had registered and its first in-person meeting was on 21 May 2026. Not AI-specific.
ai_map.ai_path: A tech-worker hub in the park, no AI stated.

ai_map.name: AITriage4SU (UTAD research project)
ai_map.what: FCT-funded UTAD project, about 124 thousand euros, building AI models and using large language models on free-text complaints to support emergency triage. Partners named are INESC TEC's UTAD pole, INEGI and a Porto hospital unit.
ai_map.ai_path: Builds AI decision support for emergency care.

ai_map.name: HUB Digital (INOV-NORTE consortium: UTAD, IPB, Politécnico do Porto)
ai_map.what: A teaching platform with an AI virtual assistant (called TOTI) for lecturers, still in training in January 2026, planned to launch in the second semester. The lead institution is not named in the report and the consortium is not based in Vila Real.
ai_map.ai_path: Builds an AI teaching assistant with UTAD.

ai_map.name: VITAL (European project, UTAD agrarian and veterinary school)
ai_map.what: European education project with 25 partners in nine countries. Its workshop at UTAD in September 2026 covered AI and precision livestock farming and the skills they demand.
ai_map.ai_path: Trains the animal production sector for AI tools.

ai_map.name: Rede de Bibliotecas de Vila Real (RBVR)
ai_map.what: Network of the municipality's school libraries. Held its third meeting on AI in education on 25 and 26 October 2024 with the council's support, and in October 2026 ran activities under a literacy and AI theme.
ai_map.ai_path: Teaches AI literacy in schools with council support.

ai_map.name: Associação Portuguesa de Imprensa (Jornadas Técnicas da Imprensa Regional 2026)
ai_map.what: National press association whose 2026 regional press days ended in Vila Real with AI in journalism as a main theme. It is not based in Vila Real as far as the report shows.
ai_map.ai_path: Convened an AI-in-news debate in Vila Real.

ai_map.name: Centro de Inovação e Desenvolvimento (UTAD)
ai_map.what: UTAD unit named on the INOV_TECH@UTAD business ideas contest and its UPGRADE proof-of-concept programme. Neither is AI-specific.
ai_map.ai_path: Runs the university's startup contest, which can carry AI ideas.

gaps: The council news page and feed (which load with a normal browser) show AI in one item only, the school libraries' literacy and AI month of October 2026, and no AI use in its own services. We should look for council minutes, procurement notices on base.gov.pt and the Vila Real e-commerce project (PRR) pages for any AI use. Third pass (17 Nov): the council feed still works and its ten newest items (to 13 Nov) have no AI mention beyond the 28 October libraries item; the Contactos page lists no business or investment desk. Minutes, base.gov.pt and the PRR e-commerce pages were not reached this pass.

A Diário da República notice for AI servers at the local health unit (ULS de Trás-os-Montes e Alto Douro, Vila Real) appeared in search, but the page needs JavaScript and gave us no text, so it is not listed. Three PRR project pages we opened for that unit mention imaging equipment and health centre upgrades with no AI. We should read the notice and the unit's own announcements.

agroportal.pt is behind a bot challenge (403), so its items on an INESC TEC robotics and AI viticulture event at UTAD in June 2025 stay unread. regiadouro.com shows a maintenance page, and regiadouropark.pt does not resolve, so the park is reached only through Lusa and UTAD news. Third pass: regiadouro.com returned 503 on 17 Nov, so it is still unreachable.
Outsmartis, Kropie and What When Where are named as DTech organisers but no page we opened says what they do or where they are based.

Feeds found for the council, Universidade.fm and UTAD news. None for Regia Douro Park, and Diário de Trás-os-Montes has no feed at the usual address. Third pass: the UTAD news and Universidade.fm feeds and the council feed all still work.
The IBM innovation centre is a 2022 announcement and we found no later report, so we do not know whether it opened.

Not sourced: CITAB's mySense platform and ForestWISE (seen only in search snippets), other UTAD research groups, UTAD Solutions Consulting's own page, and any 2025 or 2026 investment round in a Vila Real company.

Local events: DTech and the regional press days are over, and we found no upcoming AI event in Vila Real on an organiser's own page. The INOV_TECH@UTAD page shown is the 2025 edition, so a 2026 edition is unconfirmed.

Start a company: the council's site lists no business or investment desk and no incubation page that we found. Regia Douro Park's incubator and accelerator are known only from a Lusa report, with no services, price or way to apply. We still need the park's own pages once its site is back, and the Vila Real counter of Empresa na Hora. Third pass: the search for an open call at the park's incubator found none; the park's site was down, so this stays open. A search snippet of a possible expansion of the incubator was not opened and is not used.
Talent lists only three UTAD people who spoke publicly in UTAD or press reports. Nobody has agreed to be listed here, and no local AI founders were found.
The 2026 EdgeOnVespa report gives no funding amount, and the HUB Digital report does not name its lead institution or any Vila Real base.

People: no talent list yet. Three UTAD researchers appear by name in UTAD news about public AI talks and projects, but we list no named individual until PrompTugal has a rule for who may be shown and a source for their own consent.

Third pass (17 Nov): no AI news since 16 November. The UTAD feed's only new item (16 Nov, a mentoring network) and the ten Universidade.fm items of 16 Nov (including a UTAD technology, sustainability and wellbeing seminar with no AI stated) do not pass the AI test. The ULS Diário da República notice, agroportal items, DTech organisers, IBM centre and INOV_TECH 2026 edition were not re-opened with new results this pass.

voice.lede: Vila Real, ó pá: where the Marão keeps the wind out, the vines climb the terraces, and the university quietly teaches the whole North to talk to machines before lunch.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Vila Real, a nossa cidade da serra: AI and tech in Vila Real, with UTAD as the big brain among the hills and the Regia Douro Park next door, plus whatever news climbs over the Marão from Trás-os-Montes, Portugal and the world. Independente, and every fact comes with a receipt.
voice.gravity: Vila Real is where a university, a science park and a hornet-hunting AI project can share a hillside. UTAD does the heavy thinking, the Regia Douro Park houses about 160 firms, and the Câmara, bless it, lends a hand to DTech while its news page talks mostly about pottery, railways and school prizes. Muita calma, the AI story here is the campus and the park.
voice.gaps_intro: Ainda não sabemos tudo, pá. Here is what Vila Real has not told us yet:

start_company.name: Empresa na Hora (Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado)
start_company.what: Counters where all partners together can set up a limited company, sole-owner company or public limited company in one visit, choosing a pre-approved name and articles. National service, with the Vila Real counter not checked.

start_company.name: Startup Portugal
start_company.what: The national startup agency's site lists programmes, a founder's guide, a network of recognised incubators (RNi) and a startups and investors matching tool. National, not a Vila Real desk.

start_company.name: Regia Douro Park (science and technology park with an incubator and accelerator)
start_company.what: The park, with about 160 companies, hosts an incubator and accelerator. Its own site was in maintenance mode, so the details come from a Lusa report.

start_company.name: Vila Real Innovation Hub (Regia Douro Park with UTAD)
start_company.what: A community for remote workers, freelancers and digital entrepreneurs. More than 50 had registered by May 2026. The park says it may add services such as temporary housing.

start_company.name: INOV_TECH@UTAD business ideas contest
start_company.what: Contest for ideas by members of the UTAD community aged 18 to 29 with a tax address in the North, Centre or Alentejo regions. Ten ideas go to a validation lab, five to an acceleration and mentoring programme, and the top three share 6,000 euros. The page shown is the 2025 edition.

start_company.name: UPGRADE 2026 (UTAD, project UI-TRANSFER 2.0)
start_company.what: 50 thousand euros for five proof-of-concept projects of up to 10 thousand euros, in goods and services, for UTAD researchers, lecturers and students. Applications closed on 28 February 2026.

investors.name: FCT into UTAD's AITriage4SU emergency triage project
investors.what: National research funding for an AI decision-support project at UTAD, about 124 thousand euros in total.
investors.ai_path: Funds AI for emergency care: directly about AI.

investors.name: COMPETE 2030 (ERDF) into UTAD's UPGRADE 2026 programme
investors.what: European regional funding behind the UI-TRANSFER 2.0 project, which pays for five proof-of-concept projects at UTAD.
investors.ai_path: Funds university technology that may include AI, none stated: two steps from AI.

investors.name: NORTE2030 into the EdgeOnVespa consortium
investors.what: Co-finances a 36-month project using AI and edge computing against the Asian hornet, with UTAD as a partner. The report gives no amount.
investors.ai_path: Funds an AI detection project: directly about AI.
